educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic English writing skills. Students will be able to: (1) Compose grammatically correct English sentences. (2) Communicate ideas at the paragraph and essay level. (3) Apply the rules of style and formatting to written English. (4) Understand and use metalanguage associated with English writing.
advice: This course is a basic English writing course. We will cover the following areas: (1) Parts of speech (2) Combining sentences into effective paragraphs (3) Constructing an essay (4) Mechanics (5) Formatting Students are required to actively participate in the class.
books: Textbook: Trio Writing 1 (Oxford) Reference books: none Reserved books: none
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and basic computer skills are required.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Students understand English sentence structure and grammar and can apply these ideas to their original English writing. (2) Students can express their ideas in paragraph- and essay-length English writing, fully taking into account concepts like structure, format, and style.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Students exhibit some understanding of English sentence structure and grammar and can apply these ideas to their original English writing with some success. (2) Students can express their ideas in paragraph- and essay-length English writing, making adequate use of concepts like structure, format, and style.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
